open_questions: When was atorvastatin first prescribed, and at what dose?
Was the dose change from 40 mg to 20 mg intentional, and what was the clinical rationale?
What cholesterol values or cardiovascular risk assessment preceded the recommendation for atorvastatin 40 mg?
Has the patient reported any muscle symptoms, liver enzyme changes, or other adverse effects on atorvastatin?
Was pharmacy confirmation of 20 mg documented before or after the AI summary recommending 40 mg?
Are there earlier notes indicating adherence issues, titration attempts, or shared decision-making about statin dose?
Which allergies or reactions are recorded?
Which follow-ups, referrals or tests are planned or outstanding?

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Dose discrepancy between AI recommendation (40 mg) and clinician-confirmed dose (20 mg) creates risk of medication error or suboptimal therapy.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Clarify and document intended atorvastatin dose, rationale for selection, and whether 40 mg was rejected or deferred.
